description: Source file for hardware layer utilities related to MPU (Memory Protection Unit) and system fault handling on STM32F4 microcontrollers, including stack management, fault diagnostics, and SPI configuration.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates remaining stack space for a thread, with different implementations for GCC and IAR toolchains.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware, resets cycle counter, and sets BOR level.

methods.name: _unhandled_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions by panicking.

methods.name: DebugMonitorVector
methods.description: Handles debug monitor exceptions.

methods.name: UsageFaultVector
methods.description: Handles usage fault exceptions.

methods.name: BusFaultVector
methods.description: Handles bus fault exceptions.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Collects register values for postmortem debugging from a fault stack.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handles hard fault exceptions, with optional assembly code for context capture.

methods.name: isUnderDebugger
methods.description: Checks if the system is running under debugger control.

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects CAN device based on RX and TX pins.

methods.name: getSpiAf
methods.description: Returns the alternate function number for a given SPI driver.

methods.name: getMisoPin
methods.description: Returns the MISO pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getMosiPin
methods.description: Returns the MOSI pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getSckPin
methods.description: Returns the SCK pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: turnOnSpi
methods.description: Initializes SPI hardware for a specified device if not already initialized.

methods.name: initSpiModule
methods.description: Configures SPI pins and mode for a specific SPI driver.

methods.name: initSpiCs
methods.description: Initializes chip select pin for SPI communication.

methods.name: BOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves the BOR (Brown-Out Reset) level setting.

methods.name: BOR_Set
methods.description: Sets the BOR (Brown-Out Reset) level.

methods.name: isValidCan1RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 RX.

methods.name: isValidCan1TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 TX.

methods.name: isValidCan2RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 RX.

methods.name: isValidCan2TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 TX.
